item.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard for Agentic AI Workloads
item.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter open mixture-of-experts model claiming up to 4x faster output speed for agentic tasks, alongside NeMo Switchyard, an open-source routing library that dynamically directs agent requests to the optimal model in multi-model ensembles.
